python.embed_sha256_note: Computed from the python.org download on 2026-10-02; its MD5 (6d9aa08531d48fcc261ba667e2df17c4) matches the md5_sum python.org publishes for this file in its downloads API. python.org publishes no sha256 for 3.11.9.

payload_prune.reason: JupyterLab/notebook front-end assets that ipywidgets installs for notebook use (pulled in by open3d's optional web visualizer). The desktop app never runs Jupyter; three of these webpack chunks have paths over 220 characters, which put the installed path past Windows' 260-character MAX_PATH.

max_relative_path_note: Longest payload path (relative to the install folder) the build accepts. The default per-user folder LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/OpenDroneKit/ is about 52 characters plus the user name; 190 keeps every installed path under MAX_PATH (260) for user names up to about 18 characters, and the embedded Python does not opt into long paths.

forbidden_payload_allow.reason: Mozilla's public CA root bundle shipped by certifi; public certificates, no private key.
botocore's copy of the public CA root bundle; no private key.
onnxruntime's own few-KB example graphs (logreg_iris, mul_1, sigmoid) inside its wheel; not OpenDroneKit model weights.
